spec2def(srclient.dll srclient.spec)

# srclient.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/srclient-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(srclient_shims OBJECT srclient_main.c)
target_link_libraries(srclient_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(srclient srclient-cargo srclient.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS srclient_shims)
